title: Yummy Zesty Algerian Long Beans Fritters
description: Tangy, chewy fritters made from fresh Chinese long beans, spiced with cumin and paprika, then double‑fried for a crispy finish. Perfect as a festive snack or side dish.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: 2 tbsp for batter, 4 tbsp for double‑fry

instructions: Wash and trim the long beans, then cut them into 1‑inch pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the beans, diced onion, minced garlic, chopped coriander, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper; let sit for 5 minutes.
Whisk the egg, flour, and baking powder until smooth, then pour the batter over the bean mixture and stir until evenly coated.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a deep skillet over medium‑high heat until shimmering.
Drop spoonfuls of the bean batter into the hot oil, flatten slightly, and fry until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side.
Remove the fritters and drain on paper towels, then return them to the skillet with the remaining 4 tablespoons of oil to double‑fry for a crispier finish, about 1 minute per side.
Transfer the finished fritters to a plate and sprinkle with a squeeze of lemon juice for extra zest.
Serve immediately with a side of harissa‑yogurt dip or your favorite Algerian sauce.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge; reheat quickly in a skillet to regain crispness.
